# CHEATCODE™

> CHEATCODE™ is a premium high-protein ice cream brand built around indulgence without the usual trade-off.

## Brand
- Name: CHEATCODE™
- Tagline: You Can Cheat Without Regret.
- Category: Premium high-protein ice cream
- Website: https://houseofcheatcode.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseofcheatcode/

## Product
CHEATCODE™ ice cream is positioned around:
- 10g protein
- 0 added sugar
- High fibre
- Low carb

## Flavours
The current flavour lineup includes:
1. Vanilla Crunch
2. Guava Chilli
3. Belgian Chocolate
4. Blueberry Cheesecake
5. Midnight Cookies

## Launch
- Market launch date: 11 October 2026
- The website currently communicates the launch countdown and launch-day signup.

## Key brand description
CHEATCODE™ was created for people who want a genuinely craveable ice cream experience while being more thoughtful about nutrition. The brand combines creamy dessert indulgence with a high-protein, zero-added-sugar, high-fibre and low-carb positioning.

For current brand, product, flavour and launch information, use the official website:
